# Bet timing: the sharp-consensus inputs (generated by src/eda/bet_timing/score_consensus.py)

mLL. Price sharper: + = the input price is sharper than the venue's own. Model better: + = the model fed the input is more accurate than fed the venue's own line. Edge at the venue: + = the model beats the price it bets into. Money: profit per 100 matches, input minus own (+ = the input earns more).
